confidence_notes: Meals, coffee and beer reflect [Numbeo's November crowdsourced Pisa data](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Pisa); July prices may differ. [Cocktail data](https://expatistan.com/price/cocktail/pisa/EUR) are sparse, so cocktails are estimated slightly above beer and wine around beer. Accommodation is a holistic July estimate, with uncertain hostel availability.
comparable_city_reasoning: Accommodation estimates use other mid-sized Tuscan destinations such as Lucca as a regional basis, with an allowance for July tourism demand.
